note: Triennial (post-war) election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 3 October 1946. The Ballymena Weekly Telegraph nomination list names all 24 divisions: after withdrawals in Seacash and Crumlin there were four contests (Antrim Rural, Antrim Urban, Ballyrobin, Crumlin; held); Seacash and 18 other divisions had a single nominee; Cargin had no nomination and its retiring member was returned (deemed). 'No nomination, and Mr. P. C. Grant, the retiring member, will be returned.' Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
